pages.title: Not Everyone Likes Fireworks
pages.text: A suitable firework creates an opportunity to escape.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Wechuge and Wendigo threaten cold forests; Skinwalker disguises as a wolf and reveals with a screaming lunge. Fireworks create a temporary pause, not permanent safety.

pages.title: Field notes
pages.text: Cold-forest Giant Boars eat red/brown mushrooms but are dangerous nearby; tusks support weapons.

pages.title: Field notes
pages.text: Wet-forest Howlers hunt in darkness and can blind prey; carry light and plan retreat.
